sources.quote: | Model | Context | Input / 1M tokens | Cached input / 1M tokens | Output / 1M tokens |
sources.supports: Current xAI pricing distinguishes cached input from input and output; it does not establish the historic Grok 3 Fast cache-write rate.

sources.quote:
| Token type | Billing rate |
|---|---|
| Prompt tokens (non-cached) | Full prompt token price |
| Cached prompt tokens | Reduced cached prompt token price |
| Completion tokens | Full completion token price |
| Reasoning tokens | Full completion token price |
sources.supports: xAI's current caching documentation identifies cached prompt tokens as a discounted billing type but does not state an earlier Grok 3 Fast cache-write price or its effective date.

notes: The available primary-source material does not settle whether $25 cache_write was ever an official charge or give a change date. Attempts to retrieve pre/post-change Internet Archive pricing snapshots were rate-limited (429) or unavailable, so the record remains unclear.
